rv.q: Españo and Tipton bring their all as Manuel and Roland, with so much vulnerability, humor, lightness, and depth to the infinite.
Shannon Bachelder (Marianne) and Hannah Green (Rona) do great work, both individually and together.
The scene where the ending does come is the right one, and is a satisfying coda to a love story that can withstand the vagaries of time.
Loving someone isn't always easy, and the chemistry between the two performers captures both a shared history and the difficulties of two different people desperately trying to get on the same page.

cn.t: Critics largely praise PrideArts' *Constellations* for its inventive staging and thought-provoking exploration of love and parallel universes, with alternating casts adding a unique dimension to Nick Payne's intimate two-hander.
